facts.fact: Sponsored Products are cost-per-click (CPC) ads that promote individual product listings on Amazon and select premium apps and websites
facts.quote: Sponsored Products are cost-per-click (CPC) ads

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads can be created with image or video creative formats
facts.quote: create a campaign ... with image or video

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads appear on desktop and mobile browsers as well as the Amazon mobile app
facts.quote: Ads serve both on desktop and mobile browsers

facts.fact: When customers click a Sponsored Products ad, they are directed to the advertised products detail page
facts.quote: customers click your ad, they go to the advertised product detail page

facts.fact: Sponsored Products allows manual keyword selection or automatic keyword targeting by Amazon systems
facts.quote: choose keywords to target, or let Amazon systems target relevant keywords automatically

facts.fact: Sponsored Products placements include the top of, alongside, or within shopping results and on product pages on Amazon
facts.quote: displayed at the top of, alongside, or within shopping results

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads appear beyond Amazon on Amazon-owned and operated sites and third-party destinations
facts.quote: other Amazon-owned and operated sites as well as third-party destinations

facts.fact: Sponsored Products ads only appear when advertised items are in stock
facts.quote: Only appear when your advertised items are in stock

facts.fact: Sponsored Products with video saw an average 9% uplift in click-through rate compared to campaigns without video
facts.quote: average +9% uplift in click-through rate (CTR)

facts.fact: New sellers can earn up to $1000 in ad credits when they launch and spend on Sponsored Products within 30 days
facts.quote: earn up to $1000 in ad credits when they launch and spend

facts.fact: Sponsored Products is available to professional sellers, vendors, book vendors, KDP authors, and agencies
facts.quote: available for professional sellers, vendors, book vendors, Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) authors, and agencies

facts.fact: Products must be eligible for the Featured Offer to be advertised with Sponsored Products
facts.quote: be eligible for the Featured Offer in order to advertise

facts.fact: Sponsored Products campaigns have no monthly or upfront fees, advertisers pay only when a shopper clicks an ad
facts.quote: no monthly or upfront fees ... pay only for clicks

facts.fact: Sponsored Products adult products, used products, refurbished products, and products in closed categories are not eligible for advertising
facts.quote: adult products, used products, refurbished products, and products in closed categories are not eligible

facts.fact: Sponsored Products bidding requires entering a maximum amount willing to pay when a customer clicks an ad
facts.quote: bid is the maximum amount you are willing to pay when a customer clicks an ad

facts.fact: Sponsored Products uses daily budgets that are the amount willing to spend on a campaign over a calendar month
facts.quote: daily budget for your campaign ... amount you are willing to spend on a campaign over a calendar month

facts.fact: Sponsored Products daily budgets are not paced throughout the day and can be spent quickly if there is high demand
facts.quote: Daily budgets are not paced throughout the day

facts.fact: Sponsored Products daily budgets can be increased or decreased once ads are live
facts.quote: You can increase or decrease your daily budget once your ads are live

facts.fact: Sponsored Products creation steps include registering, adding products, defining targeting and bidding, choosing settings, and launching
facts.quote: Register ... Add the products ... Define your targeting, keyword, and bidding strategies

facts.fact: Sponsored Products provides tools and reports to help optimize campaign performance and measure success
facts.quote: provide a range of tools and reports to help you optimize campaign performance
